# Psalm 20 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. A-psalm of-David.

**2** May-YHWH answer-you in-the-day of-distress; may-the-name of-the-God of-Jacob set-you-on-high.

**3** May-He-send your-help from-the-sanctuary and-from-Zion may-He-support-you.

**4** May-He-remember all your-grain-offerings, and-your-burnt-offering may-He-find-acceptable. Selah.

**5** May-He-give to-you according-to your-heart, and-all your-plans may-He-fulfill.

**6** We-will-shout-for-joy in-your-salvation, and-in-the-name of-our-God we-will-set-up-banners. May-YHWH fulfill all your-requests.

**7** Now I-know that YHWH saves His-anointed; He-answers-him from-His-holy heavens with-the-saving might of-His-right-hand.

**8** These [trust] in-chariots and-these in-horses, but-we — in-the-name of-YHWH our-God we-remember.

**9** They bow-down and-fall, but-we rise and-stand-firm.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **20:8**: The contrast between military hardware (chariots, horses) and divine name is the psalm's theological center — trust in visible power vs. invisible God.

— EMET
